top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia Gets Over $12 Billion in Offers for Bond Sale
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia’s dollar-bond sale has drawn in offers exceeding $12 billion, a sign that demand for the country’s debt remains healthy despite the economic strain caused by the Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Gap Up on Leadership Shift; Shein's Market Debut | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Gap (GAP) shares jumped after naming a retail industry veteran to head Old Navy and profit outpaced estimates, offsetting a sales decline at the value chain and lower sales guidance.
- Apple's (AAPL) Tim Cook handed over the reins to John Ternus on Tuesday, capping a tenure as chief executive officer that cemented the company as an iconic global brand and turned its stock into one of the most reliable bets.
- Shein Global Holdings’ shares long-awaited market debut has come at an awkward time: the fast-fashion retailer’s peak growth years are behind it just as tariffs, regulatory pressure and intensifying competition are making its next phase harder. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Citadel Says Marshall Wace ‘Stonewalling’ in Spat Over Shatz
top_signals.summary: Citadel accused Marshall Wace of failing to adhere to a court order to hand over documents relating to the British hedge fund group’s recruitment of former Citadel portfolio manager Daniel Shatz as its global credit head.
